notes.title: French is now supported in this FREE update!
notes.content:
Heya everyone!

Thanks to your suggestions, Red Riding Hood and The Stonecutter now supports the French languages. This update is NOW available on Valve's Steam and Itch.io. 

For more information check out our landing page:
https://braverockgames.wordpress.com/brgs-volume-1-landing-page/ 

Happy reading!
